headline: WOULD YOU RATHER: pair not yet chosen
stop_reason: No exact-price pair passed (attempt 3, 2026-11-24). Verified library USD 5,000-15,000: the only identical prices are Oris 01 733 7810 variants at USD 2,200 (one model family, rejected). Other candidates rejected: Grand Seiko USD 6,900 has only retailer listings, no official US page; Tudor Black Bay current US prices are about USD 4,725-5,425 per dealers, no match. Lesson applied: switch format rather than ship a near-match pair. No project was started, so nothing is half-finished.
